scripts.lint:py: command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff check --config packages/formatters/pyproject.toml . || echo "[Warning] Ruff not installed, skipping Python linting."
scripts.lint:py:fix: command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff check --fix --config packages/formatters/pyproject.toml . || echo "[Warning] Ruff not installed, skipping Python lint fixes."
scripts.format:py:check: command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff format --check --config packages/formatters/pyproject.toml . || echo "[Warning] Ruff not installed, skipping Python format checks."
scripts.format:py:fix: command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff format --config packages/formatters/pyproject.toml . || echo "[Warning] Ruff not installed, skipping Python formatting."
scripts.format:proto:check: command -v clang-format >/dev/null 2>&1 && clang-format --style=file:packages/formatters/.clang-format --Werror -n packages/types/data.proto || echo "[Warning] Clang-format not installed, skipping Protobuf format checks."
scripts.format:proto:fix: command -v clang-format >/dev/null 2>&1 && clang-format -i --style=file:packages/formatters/.clang-format packages/types/data.proto || echo "[Warning] Clang-format not installed, skipping Protobuf formatting."
scripts.fix: npm run format:fix && npm run lint:ts:fix && npm run format:py:fix && npm run lint:py:fix && npm run format:proto:fix
scripts.check:all: npm run format:check && npm run lint:ts && npm run format:py:check && npm run lint:py && npm run format:proto:check
